Hi Alice / Karthik — looping in a short ops-first response so you have concrete options to bring to your security and procurement teams. High-level: we support three deployment patterns with clear trade-offs for control-plane residency and auditability.

1) Hosted Redwood API (fastest path) — Control plane fully Redwood-managed. Pros: fastest onboarding, lower cost. Cons: control-plane logs and metadata are retained by Redwood (we provide per-tenant segregation, query controls and SOC 2 attestations). Not ideal if you require full in-account control of metadata.

2) Dedicated compute + hosted control plane — We reserve Dedicated GPU pools for you (no multi-tenant compute), but control plane remains Redwood-managed. This reduces surface area for cross-tenant inference but leaves metadata and telemetry controlled by Redwood. Good middle ground for throughput-focused teams.

3) Private deployment (Private control plane in your VPC or on-prem) — Control plane components (auth, audit, rollout) run in your account. Options: 
   - Private control plane (VPC): Redwood provides a controller image and CloudFormation/ARM templates to deploy control-plane services into your VPC; logs stay in your S3 and can be instrumented to your SIEM.
   - On-prem bundle: air-gapped package with HSM integration for customers that require keys never leave their HSM.

Items we can supply ahead of the TD: a detailed network flows doc, an ops cutover checklist (attached: private-deploy-ops-checklist.xlsx), and a KMS integration whitepaper. For the specific asks: 
- BYOK/HSM: yes, we support customer-managed KMS and HSM-backed flows for on-prem. The key material does not leave your account in the VPC-delivered control plane model.
- Log export: we can ship logs to S3 in your account or use an HTTPS push to your SIEM; retention windows are configurable per contract.

Proposed TD agenda (60m):
- 10m: goals & constraints (LumenHealth infra/security)
- 20m: deployment patterns & network flows (us)
- 20m: KMS/BYOK demo + logging/export options (us)
- 10m: next steps & owners + timeline

Deliverables after TD: annotated isolation diagram, mapping of affected services, draft SOW language for Private deployment (if you choose that path).

Attachments: private-deploy-ops-checklist.xlsx
